Name: Cosmos Girl's Whimsigoth Furniture (CP)
Author: Cosmosgirl
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50151/50151-1785798277-1023595498.png[/img][/center]

This is my first ever mod, it was the only right thing to do as a self-proclaimed mod addict! This is an original furniture set inspired by the whimsigoth aesthetic using Content Patcher. I decided to create a mod like this because I haven't found a whimsigoth furniture set on Nexus yet. All sprite art and coding was done by me. 🥰


[color=#d5a6bd][size=4][b][u]Main features:[/u][/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Since this is my first set, it isn't super huge, I do apologize for that, I was only learning the ropes when I made this! There are only 18 pieces at the moment, not sure if I'll expand on this later down the line but if I don't, I plan to make future sets more furniture packed than this one. It comes with 2 sofas, a single and double bed, 1 armchair, 1 chair, a mirror, crystal ball, sun and moon wall decoration, 1 painting, 1 plant, 1 window, a bookshelf, dresser, candle, rug and table.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]You can find all of these in the vanilla furniture catalogue.[/color]

[size=4][b][u][color=#d5a6bd]Requirements:[/color][/u][/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]The latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][b]Content Patcher[/b][/url] is required for the mod to work.[/color]

[b][u][color=#d5a6bd][size=4]Installation Instructions:[/size][/color][/u][/b]
To install, simply unzip the file and drag the contents directly in to your mod folder. That's it!

[size=4][b][u][color=#d5a6bd]Additional Info:[/color][/u][/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]I have a lot more mods in the works including more furniture sets as well as Fashion Sense outfits with matching aesthetics to the furniture. I'm still very new to all of this so if you experience any issues with this mod, feel free to let me know in the comments. [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]I love talking about and trying out mods on my [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCE9iGPEADhPqseQMHPltSGQ][b]Youtube channel[/b][/url]. I hope to get good enough to do showcases of my own stuff in the future! 🤗❤️[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]If you want to support my modding journey further and enjoy my existing work, you can support me on [url=https://ko-fi.com/cosmosgirl][b]Kofi[/b][/url]![/color]
